A '''var'sairk''' was a birth-group or litter for the [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. When capitalized as '''Var'Sairk''', it referred to the birth-groups of the noble [[Ag'Tra]] families. Each var'sairk produced between two and six children, and all offspring from the var'sairk were of the same [[Gender/Legends|sex]].
